summary: Layer 1B expands the underfollowed public-stock universe around scarce software control planes that may become second-order beneficiaries of AI/cloud complexity: identity governance for humans, machines and AI agents; cloud exposure and secrets-risk management; software/ML supply-chain governance; and observability/security telemetry. Obvious context anchors include Palo Alto Networks/CyberArk/Venafi, IBM/HashiCorp, hyperscalers and private PKI vendors such as DigiCert; the candidate list below emphasizes US-listed small/mid-cap or niche public companies where exposure is more direct and less dominated by mega-cap AI narratives.
